name: move_to
description: Move to absolute named end-effector targets. Unnamed pose dimensions hold measured values; an unnamed gripper preserves its last commanded opening to retain grasp pressure. Motion is interpolated at 25% of dimension range per second, with a 5% per-step ceiling. A move may last at most 10 seconds; split larger moves. Bounds: {'x': [-0.5, 0.5], 'y': [-0.6, 0.6], 'z': [0.905, 1.4], 'roll': [-1.5707963267948966, 1.5707963267948966], 'pitch': [-1.5707963267948966, 1.5707963267948966], 'yaw': [-3.141592653589793, 3.141592653589793], 'gripper': [0.0, 1.0]}

name: done
description: End the trial when you believe the task is complete. The evaluator determines success.

description: End an unsuccessful trial and explain the obstacle and what you learned.
